title: sourceledger sources.toml
description: The manifest sourceledger fetches, builds and validates: one [[source]] table per input.

source.description: One input. Keys other than these are kept, for a project's own reader.

id.description: ASCII letters, digits, _ and -. Names the raw file and the output.

status.description: implemented: read by every stage. unimplemented: known, not read yet.

terms.description: The publisher's reuse terms, in their words.

license.description: The terms as an SPDX id, or LicenseRef-<name>.

redistribute.description: Whether the terms let you republish the raw file.

vintage.description: The edition you expect: text or a TOML date.

release.description: Old name for vintage. Still read, with a warning.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 the download must have.

max_bytes.description: The largest download fetch accepts. 200 MiB unless set.

format.description: How the default reader reads the file. Otherwise from the URL's extension.

sheet.description: The Excel sheet to read. The first unless set.

headers.description: Extra request headers, each value an environment variable: "env:NAME".

reason.description: A note for people. Not read.
